shortDescription: Resource module for Authentication Policy Servers

options.name: accountingPort
options.description: Accounting port of RADIUS server. It is required for RADIUS server. The range is from 1 to 65535. E.g. 1813.

options.name: authenticationPort
options.description: Authentication port of RADIUS server. It is required for RADIUS server. The range is from 1 to 65535. E.g. 1812.

options.name: ciscoIseDtos
options.description: Authentication Policy Servers's ciscoIseDtos.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_host
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center hostname.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_port
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center port.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: encryptionKey
options.description: Encryption key used to encrypt shared secret.

options.name: encryptionScheme
options.description: Type of encryption scheme for additional security.

options.name: externalCiscoIseIpAddrDtos
options.description: Authentication Policy Servers's externalCiscoIseIpAddrDtos.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. Authentication and Policy Server Identifier. Use 'Get Authentication and Policy Servers' intent API to find the identifier.

options.name: ipAddress
options.description: IP address of authentication and policy server.

options.name: isIseEnabled
options.description: Value true for Cisco ISE Server. Default value is false.

options.name: messageKey
options.description: Message key used to encrypt shared secret.

options.name: port
options.description: Port of TACACS server. It is required for TACACS server. The range is from 1 to 65535.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Type of protocol for authentication and policy server. If already saved with RADIUS, can update to RADIUS_TACACS. If already saved with TACACS, can update to RADIUS_TACACS.

options.name: pxgridEnabled
options.description: Value true for enable, false for disable. Default value is true.

options.name: retries
options.description: Number of communication retries between devices and authentication and policy server. The range is from 1 to 3.

options.name: role
options.description: Role of authentication and policy server. E.g. Primary, secondary.

options.name: sharedSecret
options.description: Shared secret between devices and authentication and policy server.

options.name: timeoutSeconds
options.description: Number of seconds before timing out between devices and authentication and policy server. The range is from 2 to 20.

options.name: useDnacCertForPxgrid
options.description: Value true to use Catalyst Center certificate for Pxgrid. Default value is false.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
